bio: I'm currently a Ph.D. student (2026 - 2030) in the Department of Computer Science and Engineering at The Chinese University of Hong Kong (CUHK), supervised by James Cheng. My current research focuses on embodied intelligence and foundation models, with interests in multimodal learning, reinforcement learning and generalizable agents. Previously, I received my master's degree from Peking University (2023 - 2026), supervised by Zongqing Lu, and my bachelor's degree from Nankai University (2019 - 2023), supervised by Jingtai Liu. Feel free to drop me an email to discuss or share wonderful ideas!

papers.title: The Floor Is Not the Limit: Recovering Atmospheric Backscatter from Spaceborne Lidar via Physics-Aligned Encoding
papers.author: Tianchi Xu, Yuanpeng He, Jintao Xu, Kang He, Linyu Li, Huanyao Zhang, Dongming Jin, Bohan Zhou, Wenpin Jiao, Zhi Jin
papers.summary: Retrieving atmospheric backscatter with a parameter-free encoding derived from the lidar attenuation relation, retaining recorded low-SNR measurements below the nominal noise floor. Introduces PhysicalSDC and the paired AtmosBench benchmark to evaluate retrieval while distinguishing low-SNR measurements from invalid cells.

image.alt: Atmospheric backscatter retrieval comparison with PhysicalSDC and baseline methods

papers.title: RoboAware: Learning to Coordinate Embodied Skills from Counterfactual Outcomes
papers.author: Bohan Zhou, et al. (2026)
papers.summary: First author and project lead. Learning state-dependent coordination between modular skills and end-to-end policies from same-state counterfactual outcomes, with low-level executors frozen. Averaged 77.0% success across reported evaluation splits covering 100 tasks on three benchmarks, with zero-shot deployment on long-horizon real-robot tasks.

image.alt: RoboAware: state-locked counterfactual search, execution-aware Q-learning and closed-loop deployment

papers.title: FETCH: Frame-grounded Evidence Topology for Embodied Spatial Planning with the Counterfactual Hypothesis
papers.author: Bohan Zhou, et al. (2026)
papers.summary: First author and project lead. Connecting reference-frame-grounded evidence to executable plans with counterfactual necessity checks. Typed multi-token prediction enables 3.78× faster decoding; the planner reaches 90% real-robot success on the evaluated table-clearing task with a fixed low-level executor.

image.alt: FETCH overview: evidence distillation, FETCH-7B and FETCH-Bench

papers.summary: A 4B grounding model built on visual primitives, evaluated on 34 grounding benchmarks and downstream physical-intelligence tasks. Reached Hugging Face Daily Papers #1.

papers.title: DARA: Few-shot Budget Allocation in Online Advertising via In-Context Decision Making with RL-Finetuned LLMs
papers.author: Mingxuan Song, Yusen Huo, Bohan Zhou, Shenglin Yin, Zhen Xiao*, Jieyi Long, Zhilin Zhang, Chuan Yu*
papers.summary: Separating few-shot budget planning from feedback-driven numerical refinement with a dual-agent LLM framework. GRPO-Adaptive periodically refreshes the reference policy during RL post-training to improve allocation decisions under limited advertiser data.

papers.title: Cradle: Empowering Foundation Agents towards General Computer Control
papers.author: Weihao Tan, Wentao Zhang, Xinrun Xu, Haochong Xia, Ziluo Ding, Boyu Li, Bohan Zhou, Junpeng Yue, Jiechuan Jiang, Yewen Li, Ruyi An, Molei Qin, Chuqiao Zong, Longtao Zheng, YuJie Wu, Xiaoqiang Chai, Yifei Bi, Tianbao Xie, Pengjie Gu, Xiyun Li, Ceyao Zhang, Long Tian, Chaojie Wang, Xinrun Wang, Börje F. Karlsson, Bo An, Shuicheng Yan, Zongqing Lu
papers.summary: General computer control through screenshots and keyboard/mouse actions. Contributed low-level interaction and an evolving skill library; demonstrated approximately 40-minute storyline missions in Red Dead Redemption 2.

papers.title: Being-0: A Humanoid Robotic Agent with Vision-Language Models and Modular Skills
papers.author: Haoqi Yuan, Yu Bai, Yuhui Fu, Bohan Zhou, Yicheng Feng, Xinrun Xu, Yi Zhan, Börje F. Karlsson, Zongqing Lu (2025)
papers.summary: Hierarchical humanoid control combining vision-language planning, navigation and dexterous skills, with tens-of-meters navigation and coffee delivery on Unitree H1.

papers.title: Cross-Embodiment Dexterous Grasping with Reinforcement Learning
papers.author: Haoqi Yuan, Bohan Zhou, Yuhui Fu, Zongqing Lu
papers.summary: Learning one vision-based grasping policy across dexterous hands through human eigengrasp actions, embodiment-specific retargeting and a shared fingertip/palm observation space. The learned policy transfers zero-shot to two unseen hand embodiments in simulation.

papers.title: AERO: Enhancing Sharding Blockchain via Deep Reinforcement Learning for Account Migration
papers.author: Mingxuan Song, Pengze Li, Bohan Zhou, Shenglin Yin, Zhen Xiao, Jieyi Long
papers.summary: Reducing account-migration complexity by grouping blockchain accounts by address prefix and learning group-level migration decisions with reinforcement learning. AEROChain integrates this policy into decentralized shard reconfiguration to reduce cross-shard transactions and balance workloads.

papers.title: UniCode: Learning a Unified Codebook for Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.author: Sipeng Zheng, Bohan Zhou, Yicheng Feng, Zongqing Lu
papers.summary: Learning a shared visual-text codebook through language-driven iterative training, enabling image generation beyond text-only vocabularies. In-context image decompression and stacked quantization support compact visual tokens for multimodal understanding and generation.

papers.title: Pre-trained Visual Dynamics Representations for Efficient Policy Learning
papers.author: Hao Luo, Bohan Zhou, Zongqing Lu
papers.summary: Pretraining visual dynamics from action-free video with a Transformer-based conditional VAE. Online adaptation aligns the learned dynamics with executable robot actions, addressing the domain gap between pretraining videos and downstream visual control.

papers.title: Towards General Computer Control: A Multi Modal Agent For Red Dead Redemption II As A Case Study
papers.author: Weihao Tan, Ziluo Ding, Wentao Zhang, Boyu Li, Bohan Zhou, Junpeng Yue, Haochong Xia, Jiechuan Jiang, Longtao Zheng, Xinrun Xu, Yifei Bi, Pengjie Gu, Xinrun Wang, Börje F. Karlsson, Bo An, Zongqing Lu
papers.summary: Introducing General Computer Control through screenshot observations and keyboard/mouse actions, without game-specific control APIs. Combines self-reflection, task inference, skill curation and memory to complete storyline missions in Red Dead Redemption II.

papers.title: Learning from Visual Observation via Offline Pretrained State-to-Go Transformer
papers.author: Bohan Zhou, Ke Li, Jiechuan Jiang, Zongqing Lu
papers.summary: Learning behavioral priors from offline video and converting them into intrinsic rewards for online reinforcement learning without environment rewards.

papers.title: GFIE: A Dataset and Baseline for Gaze-Following from 2D to 3D in Indoor Environments
papers.author: Zhengxi Hu, Yuxue Yang, Xiaolin Zhai, Dingye Yang, Bohan Zhou, Jingtai Liu
papers.summary: Collecting 2D/3D gaze targets with Azure Kinect and a laser rangefinder, using laser-spot localization and removal to obtain labels without subjective annotation or wearable eye trackers. Introduces a stereo field-of-view baseline for indoor gaze following.

papers.title: Gaze Target Estimation Inspired by Interactive Attention
papers.author: Zhengxi Hu , Kunxu Zhao , Bohan Zhou, Hang Guo , Shichao Wu , Yuxue Yang, Jingtai Liu
papers.summary: Inferring human-object interaction probabilities with a visual-spatial graph attention network and converting them into an interactive attention map. A Transformer integrates scene and head features to localize gaze targets with this interaction cue.

experience.title: KnowinAI
experience.body: Robot Deployment and Embodied Skill Coordination.
experience.description: Delivered Astra simulation/real-robot evaluations and dual-arm dexterous systems, integrating perception, control and hardware. Led RoboAware, learning state-dependent coordination from same-state counterfactual branches with MCTS and Q-learning while keeping low-level executors frozen.

experience.title: BeingBeyond
experience.body: Embodied Foundation Models and Dexterous Systems.
experience.description: Contributed the human-video data pipeline for Being-H0, combining MEgoHand, TASTE-Rob and EgoDex for robot-policy transfer. Helped develop RealDexUMI, a wearable dexterous data-collection system with isomorphic control and integrated vision-tactile end effectors.

experience.title: Momenta
experience.description: Built a scenario-mining and cleaning loop, raising intersection-action recognition from about 70% to 97% and reducing annotation costs by 51%–62%. Coordinated R6 post-training at the 128-GPU scale and led Flow Matching trajectory generation with FPO safety enhancement, with 30 km of IM LS6 road testing at >10 Hz; the approach entered current products.

experience.title: JD Explore Academy
experience.description: Helped build EgoLive: 1,680 hours, 65K episodes and 346 manipulation tasks in unconstrained real environments, with stereo RGB/IMU, hand reconstruction, 3D reconstruction and semantic annotation. Transferred MEgoHand pretraining to VLA-H2 dexterous policies through object modeling, cross-embodiment retargeting and trajectory optimization.

experience.title: Beijing Academy of Artificial Intelligence (BAAI)
experience.body: Research Intern · Generalist and Embodied Agents.
experience.description: Worked on video-driven policy learning, visual navigation and multimodal dexterous manipulation: STG, NOLO, MEgoHand and BiDexHD. Produced four first-author papers; STG, NOLO and MEgoHand were featured by Prof. Zongqing Lu at the BAAI Conference in three consecutive years, 2023–2025.
